steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 3 || !String(lines[1]).includes('oil lamp')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the three scripted lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 2`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the hide: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); const lamp = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((e) => e.tier === 'facts' && /oil lamp/.test(e.text)); if (!lamp) throw new Error('the lamp fact never landed, so there is nothing for the hide to keep'); return { values, lampFact: lamp.id, boundary: state.boundary };

const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; if (chat.length !== 3) throw new Error(`/hide changed the chat length to ${chat.length}; it must only flag the row`); if (chat[1].is_system !== true) throw new Error(`message 1 is not hidden (is_system=${JSON.stringify(chat[1].is_system)}), so the rest of this fixture would prove nothing`); return { hidden: 1, mes: chat[1].mes };
const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat; if (chat[1].is_system === true) throw new Error('/unhide did not clear is_system on message 1'); return { unhidden: 1 };
